name: folder-picker
title: Folder Picker
description: A folder chooser built on FilesViewer, in a dialog or an embedded panel (autoFocus: its path field focused as it is shown, as the dialog's). Columns or a tree, with a path field, places and optional folder creation; files hidden or disabled for context. Enter goes into a folder, Cmd or Ctrl with Enter chooses it; Escape restores an edited path or cancels folder creation before closing the dialog. On a phone it fills the screen and shows one folder at a time, a flat list: a tap goes into a folder, the breadcrumb goes back up, Choose picks the folder shown, and the places are a select standing for the place's root at the start of the breadcrumb (chosen again, back to the root). On a larger screen the path field sits in the browser's toolbar, the only location and filter: no breadcrumb, no toolbar filter; the places a list with their icons. A folder with no path leaves the field empty with its placeholder. The count is the level being picked in. The dialog's footer is whole on a phone, above the home indicator. The tree, loading, paths, places, creating folders and whether a folder can be chosen are the app's. Loads deduplicate hover and focus prefetch with abort signals and independent loading columns. The typed path steers the browser: its last segment filters the folder typed into (only that level, VS Code style), n of m items in the status bar, No matches where none do; the first match is selected with inline completion, Up/Down cycle the filtered folders, Tab steps in, and with no match the typed folder itself is selected. Columns resize on a larger screen, with widths passed through to FilesViewer.
